3d-affordance-keypoint-detection-for-rob.en: Predicts affordance segmentation plus 3D keypoint quadruplets from RGB-D, giving manipulators executable position, direction, and extent for each affordance.

3d-affordancellm-harnessing-large-langua.en: Pairs LLM-generated open-vocabulary affordance queries with a 3D encoder-decoder that grounds them to point-level masks, showing LLM commonsense aids 3D detection.

3d-affordancenet.en: Object point clouds with per-point affordance labels, benchmarking 3D affordance segmentation/estimation under full-shape, partial-view, and rotation-invariant settings.

3d-affordancenet-a-benchmark-for-visual-.en: Benchmarks dense affordance prediction on object point clouds, moving affordance grounding from 2D masks onto physically meaningful 3D surfaces.

3daffordsplat.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting assets with affordance annotations, benchmarking 3DGS-based affordance reasoning, segmentation, and recognition.

3daffordsplat-efficient-affordance-reaso.en: Represents objects with 3D Gaussian splatting and predicts task-conditioned affordances on renderable Gaussian features, making 3DGS an efficient reasoning substrate.

a-deep-learning-approach-to-object-affor.en: Mines spatio-temporal cues from human-object interaction videos to supervise affordance segmentation, showing dynamics reveal usable regions static appearance misses.

a-large-scale-multi-view-rgbd-visual-aff.en: Provides 47K multi-view RGB-D images across 37 object categories with 15 affordance labels, exposing geometric affordance biases beyond single-view 2D appearance.

a-multi-scale-cnn-for-affordance-segment.en: Fuses depth, normals, and surface cues in a multi-scale CNN to predict scene affordance maps, grounding affordance in mid-level geometry rather than object category.

a-visual-affordance-reasoning-network-ba.en: Organizes objects and context into a visual graph and uses graph attention to aggregate affordance-relevant relations, making relational reasoning learnable.

a0-an-affordance-aware-hierarchical-mode.en: Predicts contact points and post-contact trajectories, then executes via cross-embodiment low-level controllers, using affordance as an interpretable intermediate layer.

a1-a-fully-transparent-open-source-adapt.en: Exploits implicit affordance priors in a pretrained VLM for action generation, with truncated flow matching and budget-aware early exit for real-time VLA control.

a2a-bench.en: Scene images with task-conditioned part affordance labels, benchmarking single- and multi-region instruction correspondence and real-time manipulation grounding.

a3d-adaptive-affordance-assembly-with-du.en: Updates support and stabilization affordances from assembly feedback to adaptively generate dual-arm actions, treating assembly affordance as dynamic and cooperative.

a3r-agentic-affordance-reasoning-via-cro.en: Trains an MLLM policy with GRPO to iteratively acquire 2D view and 3D Gaussian evidence, framing scene affordance reasoning as sequential evidence acquisition.

a4-agent-an-agentic-framework-for-zero-s.en: Decomposes zero-shot affordance prediction into a training-free how/what/where pipeline of Dreamer, Thinker, and Spotter agents, improving novel-object generalization.

a4bench.en: Image-based QA benchmark probing MLLM affordance perception and reasoning, evaluating both constitutive and transformative affordance understanding.

adaafford-learning-to-adapt-manipulation.en: Adapts manipulation affordance predictions with few-shot test-time interactions, calibrating hidden articulation and dynamics that static vision cannot reveal.

adaptive-binarization-for-weakly-supervi.en: Trains affordance segmentation from sparse keypoints with adaptive threshold estimation, showing converting soft predictions into masks is a core weak-supervision step.

ade-affordance.en: Scene images with action-object affordance annotations, benchmarking affordance reasoning along with explanation and consequence prediction.

affogato.en: 3D objects with text-paired affordance region annotations, benchmarking open-vocabulary text-to-3D affordance grounding.

affogato-learning-open-vocabulary-afford.en: Automates 150K text-object-affordance annotations to train open-vocabulary text-to-3D heatmap grounding, scaling coverage to long-tail interaction descriptions.

afford-vla-action-aligned-visual-plannin.en: Jointly predicts <AFF> tokens and affordance masks alongside actions as internalized signals, organizing VLA visual planning without explicit policy conditioning.

afford-x-generalizable-and-slim-affordan.en: Trains a slim 187M-parameter model with verb attention and bi-fusion on the LVIS-Aff dataset, showing task-oriented affordance reasoning does not require a large MLLM.

affordance-agent-harness-verification-ga.en: Routes among heterogeneous perception skills with episodic memory and cost control, gating commits through an affordance verifier that triggers targeted retries.

affordance-based-robot-manipulation-with.en: Unifies prompt-tuned affordance prediction and continuous trajectory generation in one supervised flow matching framework for manipulation.

affordance-benchmark-for-mllms.en: Benchmarks MLLM affordance QA and grounding across commonsense, regional, and physical axes, exposing a gap between recognizing objects and judging interactions.

affordance-detection-for-task-specific-g.en: Predicts affordance maps jointly with object class and orientation, then uses them as task-specific grasp constraints, making manipulation a validation of perception.

affordance-driven-next-best-view-plannin.en: Imagines grasp affordances under unobserved viewpoints and selects the next-best view accordingly, folding active perception into the affordance-to-grasp loop.

affordance-field-intervention-enabling-v.en: Builds 3D spatial affordance fields as a plug-in that scores and corrects VLA waypoints at runtime, detecting memory traps and restoring spatial feasibility.

affordance-grounding-from-demonstration-.en: Extracts interaction cues from a demonstration video to ground action-conditioned affordance heatmaps on a target image of the same object class.

affordance-guided-enveloping-grasp-demon.en: Generates enveloping-grasp affordance templates in physics simulation to guide teleoperated demonstrations for non-destructive disassembly of pinch-infeasible parts.

affordance-learning-from-play-for-sample.en: Extracts self-supervised visual affordances from human teleoperated play and couples them with model-based planning and RL, cutting robot interaction samples.

affordance-r1-reinforcement-learning-for.en: Applies GRPO reinforcement learning post-training to an MLLM with format, perception, and cognition rewards, markedly improving interpretable affordance grounding.

affordance2action-task-conditioned-scene.en: Builds task-conditioned scene-level part affordance supervision with A2A-Bench and uses it as explicit conditions or implicit representations for real-time grasping.

affordancegrasp-r1-leveraging-reasoning-.en: Cold-starts an MLLM with chain-of-thought data, then optimizes affordance segmentation with RL rewards to calibrate spatial grounding for grasping.

affordancelearn-learning-affordance-segm.en: Generates pixel-level affordance labels in simulation and trains segmentation networks that transfer sim-to-real, showing simulation supplies scalable dense supervision.

affordancellm-grounding-affordance-from-.en: Fuses MLLM-generated part and function priors with a visual grounding network to predict affordance heatmaps, injecting commonsense semantics beyond texture cues.

affordancenet-an-end-to-end-deep-learnin.en: Extends Mask R-CNN-style instance segmentation with an affordance branch, establishing end-to-end detection plus instance-level affordance masks as a standard baseline.

affordances-from-human-videos-as-a-versa.en: Learns contact points and post-contact trajectories from human videos, serving as a versatile affordance interface for imitation, exploration, and RL.

affordancesam-segment-anything-once-more.en: Adapts SAM/EVF-SAM with a lightweight affordance adapter and coarse-to-fine training, turning a segmentation foundation model into a functional-region predictor.

affordancevla-a-vision-language-action-m.en: Jointly predicts Which2Act, Where2Act, and How2Act signals as internal affordance representations, improving VLA interpretability and generalization in manipulation.

affordbot-3d-fine-grained-embodied-reaso.en: Renders 3D scenes into multi-view images for MLLM chain-of-thought reasoning that outputs affordance elements with motion type and axis, going beyond masks.

affordbridge.en: Image-3D pairs bridging visual signifiers to 3D scenes, benchmarking scene-level affordance grounding and cross-modal keypoint matching.

afforddexgrasp-open-set-language-guided-.en: Generates instructive affordance from language via flow matching, then samples dexterous grasps with a grasp flow, bridging open-set instructions and high-DoF hands.

afforddp-generalizable-diffusion-policy-.en: Conditions a diffusion policy on transferable 3D contact points and post-contact trajectories, improving generalization to unseen object instances and categories.

affordgen-generating-diverse-demonstrati.en: Transfers grasp and skill trajectories to novel objects via 3D mesh affordance correspondence, expanding few demonstrations into diverse data for closed-loop policies.

affordgrasp-in-context-affordance-reason.en: Infers task goal, target object, and functional part from implicit instructions with a VLM, grounding part-level masks for task-oriented grasping in clutter.

affordmatcher-affordance-learning-in-3d-.en: Matches 2D visual signifiers to 3D scene instances via cross-modal keypoint correspondence on the AffordBridge dataset, learning scene affordances from signifier cues.

affordpose.en: 3D hand-object interaction data with fine-grained affordance labels, benchmarking hand-object affordance understanding and affordance-oriented hand pose generation.

affordq.en: 3D object point clouds paired with natural-language queries, benchmarking language-guided affordance segmentation on 3D shapes.

affordvla-injecting-affordance-represent.en: Aligns intermediate VLA visual features with an affordance teacher through implicit losses, improving manipulation while preserving end-to-end simplicity.

affostruction-3d-affordance-grounding-wi.en: Reconstructs full object geometry from partial RGB-D via generative completion, grounding text-queried affordances on occluded surfaces and guiding active view selection.

afun-towards-an-affordance-foundation-mo.en: Standardizes robot, human, and simulation data into language-mask-motion labels to train a foundation model predicting where and how to interact from one RGB-D frame.

agd20k.en: 20K exocentric-egocentric image pairs for affordance grounding, benchmarking exo-to-ego transfer plus one-shot and open affordance grounding.

agddo15.en: Egocentric images of deformable objects in organizing scenes, benchmarking one-shot affordance grounding and functional-region localization.

agentic-scene-policies-unifying-space-se.en: Unifies semantic, spatial, and affordance queries over a queryable scene representation into an agentic interface that selects targets and primitive skills for planning.

agile-learning-robust-long-horizon-manip.en: Plans latent subgoals backward with forward-critic reachability checks, grounding each subgoal into task-relevant visual regions that condition a diffusion policy.

agpil.en: Image-3D pairs for language-guided 3D affordance grounding, with evaluation splits covering full, partial, and rotation-view observations.

an-affordance-keypoint-detection-network.en: Shares one visual backbone to output affordance masks plus interaction keypoints with direction and extent, extending affordance from regions to actionable operation geometry.

arg-vu-affordance-reasoning-with-physics.en: Combines 3D Gaussian splatting with XPBD physics-aware compliance energy for surgical affordance reasoning, making deformable feasibility explicit.

bayesian-deep-learning-for-affordance-se.en: Adds Monte Carlo dropout to Mask R-CNN to estimate aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty, exposing boundary noise and visually hard regions in affordance segmentation.

biassemble-learning-collaborative-afford.en: Predicts point-level collaborative affordances for each arm and derives grasp, support, and sequencing actions for bimanual geometric assembly.

bipremanip-learning-affordance-based-bim.en: Envisions the final action first, then plans the assisting hand's preparatory affordance manipulation, encoding anticipatory collaboration in bimanual affordance.

bootstrapping-relational-affordances-of-.en: Learns transferable pairwise relations from object-pair interactions, showing affordances can be defined by functional relations between objects, not single objects.

bridgeact-bridging-human-demonstrations-.en: Unifies tool-target affordances from human videos, decomposing them into where-to-grasp and how-to-move signals that bridge human demonstrations to robot actions.

cal.en: Paired images capturing contact-driven human-object interactions for interactive affinity learning, benchmarking affordance grounding.

closed-loop-transfer-for-weakly-supervis.en: Cycles pseudo labels between exocentric and egocentric grounding with reverse consistency checks, letting predictions correct the noise of single-pass cross-view transfer.

coa-vla-improving-vision-language-action.en: Generates object, grasp, spatial, and movement affordances as a chain and co-injects them visually and textually into a VLA policy to improve action prediction.

compassad-intent-driven-3d-affordance-gr.en: Grounds implicit intent in 3D scenes with functionally competing objects, showing task intent selects both the correct object and its interaction region.

contactdb.en: Paired 3D object shapes and images capturing human grasp contact maps, benchmarking functional grasp contact prediction and contact-map affordance reasoning.

context-based-affordance-segmentation-fr.en: Fuses object, part, and scene-context cues for 2D affordance segmentation, showing contextual part relations track action possibility better than object category alone.

dag-unleash-the-potential-of-diffusion-m.en: Extracts frozen diffusion features from HOI images and affordance text and fuses them with point clouds, turning generative priors into open-vocabulary 3D grounding.

dart-a-novel-task-driven-diffusion-based.en: Couples LTL task semantics with affordance interaction points in a diffusion policy, showing logic and affordance jointly improve articulated-object generalization.

defoafford-learning-foresightful-dense-v.en: Learns dense foresightful affordance value maps that predict multi-step deformation outcomes, guiding pick-and-place actions for deformable object manipulation.

demo2vec-reasoning-object-affordances-fr.en: Encodes demonstration videos into embeddings that ground interaction regions and actions on object images, showing online videos supply cheap affordance supervision.

detecting-object-affordances-with-convol.en: Feeds RGB and HHA depth encodings into a CNN to detect pixel-level object affordances, showing learned deep features replace handcrafted geometry for real grasping.

do-as-i-can-not-as-i-say-grounding-langu.en: Scores LLM-proposed skills with learned value functions as affordances, multiplying language plausibility by embodied feasibility to select executable robot actions.

dora-object-affordance-guided-reinforcem.en: Injects affordance maps into dexterous RL as action priors, constraints, and reward shaping, narrowing search while calibrating functional contact.

dualafford-learning-collaborative-visual.en: Decomposes dual-gripper manipulation into collaborative sub-tasks that predict paired contact affordances, showing bimanual affordance is not additive over single arms.

ego-topo-environment-affordances-from-eg.en: Organizes egocentric video into activity-centric zones linked in a topological graph, showing affordances attach to functional environment zones, not single objects.

embodied-spatial-affordance-spatial-awar.en: Jointly reasons over object and free-space affordances in a hierarchical vision-language model, lifting 2D keypoints through depth into 3D actionable coordinates.

epic-aff.en: Egocentric kitchen videos lifted into 3D, benchmarking multi-label affordance segmentation, 3D spatial affordance mapping, and task-oriented navigation.

epic-kitchens-affordance.en: Egocentric kitchen video frames with affordance labels, benchmarking affordance recognition, hand-object interaction hotspot prediction, and cross-domain evaluation.

esa.en: RGB and RGB-D images annotated with object and free-space affordance keypoints, benchmarking spatial affordance reasoning for embodied navigation and manipulation.

fine-grained-affordance-annotation-for-e.en: Defines affordance through motor actions and grasp types, adding fine-grained hand-object labels to EPIC-KITCHENS that separate functionality, goal action, and motor capacity.

forecasting-human-object-interaction-joi.en: Jointly forecasts hand motion, motor attention, and future actions in first-person video, framing future contact hotspots as a temporal form of affordance prediction.

fsag-enhancing-human-to-dexterous-hand-f.en: Extracts finger-specific contact affordances from human videos via diffusion models and retargets them to varied dexterous hands, enabling finger-level transfer.

functionality-understanding-and-segmenta.en: Chains LLM reasoning over task descriptions with VLM multi-view segmentation lifted to 3D point clouds, giving a training-free baseline for functionality grounding.

garmentpile-point-level-visual-affordanc.en: Learns point-level pull and grasp affordances on garment piles and rearranges entangled items before grasping, modeling inter-object relations in deformable clutter.

gcngrasp-vp-affordance-guided-view-plann.en: Uses a jointly predicted affordance field as the information-gain metric for next-best-view planning, showing affordances guide where to look as well as where to grasp.

geal-generalizable-3d-affordance-learnin.en: Distills 2D foundation semantics into 3D via Gaussian-splatting-based cross-modal consistency, keeping affordance predictions robust on novel and corrupted point clouds.

glance-intermediate-connectors-and-geome.en: Inserts intermediate connectors between language queries and point features and adds geometric priors, stabilizing affordance masks on unseen object categories.

glover-generalizable-open-vocabulary-aff.en: Reasons about graspable parts with LLM/VLM open-vocabulary inference and converts affordance regions into grasp poses through an AGE planner.

glover-unleashing-the-potential-of-affor.en: Mines affordance supervision from human behavior videos to build HOVA-500K, showing large-scale human data markedly broadens transferable robotic affordance grounding.

great-geometry-intention-collaborative-i.en: Combines geometric analogy with interaction-intention chain-of-thought reasoning, grounding open-vocabulary 3D affordances by inferring both cues jointly on novel objects.

grounded-affordance-from-exocentric-view.en: Extracts affordance-specific features from exocentric interactions and transfers them across views, tackling person-specific interaction bias in egocentric grounding.

grounded-decoding-guiding-text-generatio.en: Injects grounded model scores into LLM decoding to re-rank action tokens, bringing affordance constraints into generation itself rather than post-hoc filtering.

grounded-human-object-interaction-hotspo.en: Learns interaction hotspots from unlabeled videos by hallucinating active features on static images, turning human demonstrations into weak affordance supervision.

grounding-3d-object-affordance-from-2d-i.en: Aligns 2D human-object interaction images with point clouds to ground 3D object affordance, showing interaction cues transfer across modalities to functional regions.

grounding-3d-object-affordance-with-lang.en: Fuses language instructions, 2D observations, 3D geometry, and interaction cues to ground 3D object affordances, exploiting the complementarity of the three evidence types.

grounding-3d-scene-affordance-from-egoce.en: Aggregates egocentric interaction evidence onto scene point clouds, using first-person interaction history as supervision for 3D scene affordance grounding.

grounding-by-remembering-cross-scene-and.en: Augments a frozen VLM with cross-scene affordance memory and in-scene spatial memory retrieval, compensating for VLM neglect of small functional parts.

grounding-language-with-visual-affordanc.en: Learns a visuo-lingual affordance model from unstructured reset-free data, enabling long-horizon language-conditioned real-robot tasks with few annotations.

hierarchical-transformer-for-visual-affo.en: Applies a hierarchical vision transformer over multiple scales to segment multi-view RGB-D object affordances, handling varied object sizes and multi-region labels.

hova-500k.en: 500K-scale image collection of human-object interactions for human-behavior affordance grounding and affordance transfer to robotic manipulation.

iaao-interactive-affordance-learning-for.en: Builds 3DGS-based object and articulation models updated through interaction, jointly refining part motion estimates and affordances of articulated objects.

iit-aff.en: RGB images of everyday objects annotated for object detection, instance/semantic segmentation, and pixel-level affordance detection and segmentation.

information-driven-affordance-discovery-.en: Selects interaction actions by information gain to actively discover object affordances, making data collection itself driven by affordance uncertainty.

instructpart.en: Images paired with task instructions and part-level masks, benchmarking task-oriented part segmentation, instruction-conditioned grounding, and VLM part reasoning.

instructpart-task-oriented-part-segmenta.en: Builds a benchmark of hand-labeled part masks paired with task instructions, revealing VLMs still treat objects as wholes and must ground tasks at the part level.

intention-related-natural-language-groun.en: Combines attention-based affordance detection with intention semantic extraction to ground implicit queries, treating affordance as the intent-to-target semantic bridge.

intra-interaction-relationship-aware-wea.en: Learns text-conditioned affordance maps from exocentric images alone via interaction-relation contrastive learning, dropping the need for paired egocentric data.

joint-hand-motion-and-interaction-hotspo.en: Predicts future hand trajectories and interaction hotspots jointly from egocentric video with an object-centric transformer, letting the two cues reinforce each other.

knowledge-enhanced-bottom-up-affordance-.en: Fuses knowledge-enhanced text features with multilevel visual features bottom-up, showing commonsense is key for mapping implicit instructions to affordance parts.

language-embedded-radiance-fields-for-ze.en: Distills CLIP embeddings into a 3D language field and queries object parts with DINO-masked text, ranking grasp candidates for zero-shot task-oriented grasping.

laso-language-guided-affordance-segmenta.en: Segments 3D object affordance from language queries by generating dynamic kernels from text that convolve point features, conditioning masks on referring expressions.

learning-2d-invariant-affordance-knowled.en: Distills an invariant affordance dictionary from multiple 2D interaction images into point features, making cross-image consensus steadier than single-image HOI cues.

learning-6-dof-task-oriented-grasp-detec.en: Estimates 3D affordance heatmaps with implicit shape representations from point clouds, then generates and scores task-oriented 6-DoF grasp poses.

learning-affordance-grounding-from-exoce.en: Learns object affordance heatmaps from exocentric human-object interaction images, establishing AGD20K and human behavior as low-cost affordance supervision.

learning-affordance-landscapes-for-inter.en: Trains an RL agent to explore 3D scenes for interaction rewards while distilling an affordance segmenter, showing active interaction self-supervises scene affordance.

learning-affordance-space-in-physical-wo.en: Learns a physical affordance space from visual observations and uses the predicted actionable regions to plan robotic object manipulation.

learning-dexterous-grasping-with-object-.en: Embeds object-centric grasp affordance priors into deep RL rewards and observations, constraining high-dimensional dexterous hand policy search.

learning-environment-aware-affordance-fo.en: Fuses occluded point clouds, environment geometry, and robot morphology to predict feasible action regions, showing manipulability depends on scene and embodiment.

learning-generalizable-dexterous-manipul.en: Generates large-scale demonstrations from a human grasp affordance model to train dexterous policies that generalize across object categories.

learning-grasp-affordance-reasoning-thro.en: Uses Markov Logic Networks over attribute-affordance relations to infer task-specific grasp regions, selecting functional grasps instead of enumerating graspable areas.

learning-precise-affordances-from-egocen.en: Extracts precise hand-object contact masks from egocentric videos to train an affordance detector, showing fine masks outperform coarse heatmaps for functional grasping.

learning-to-act-properly-predicting-and-.en: Builds ADE-Affordance and propagates scene-level object relations with a GNN, showing affordances depend on social norms and context, not just local geometry.

learning-to-segment-affordances.en: Derives dense scene affordance labels from object and part annotations and refines them with a CNN, showing part structure serves as effective intermediate supervision.

lemon-learning-3d-human-object-interacti.en: Jointly infers human contact, object affordance, and 3D spatial relation from one image, arguing these interaction cues should be modeled together, not in isolation.

leverage-interactive-affinity-for-afford.en: Extracts body-part-to-object contact affinities from HOI images via pose heuristics, reducing label ambiguity when transferring affordance to non-interactive objects.

lgafford-net-a-local-geometry-aware-affo.en: Encodes local surface geometry and neighborhood structure for point-cloud affordance detection, showing regional cues beat purely global features for localization.

llmaff.en: Images annotated for natural-language affordance grounding, benchmarking language-conditioned affordance localization across multiple objects per scene.

locate-localize-and-transfer-object-part.en: Localizes and transfers object-part prototypes between exocentric and egocentric views, using part priors to curb region drift under weak supervision.

manipgpt-is-affordance-segmentation-by-l.en: Pairs large-vision-model affordance segmentation with an impedance-adaptive controller, showing LVM masks need lightweight control adaptation for articulated objects.

manipulation-oriented-object-perception-.en: Detects object parts in clutter and predicts category-level affordance coordinate frames, unifying functional parts and 3D pose into one manipulation-ready output.

manipvqa-injecting-robotic-affordance-an.en: Fine-tunes an MLLM on robotic affordance and physics VQA instruction data, showing generic MLLMs need manipulation-specific supervision to ground tool concepts.

maskprompt-open-vocabulary-affordance-se.en: Injects object shape mask prompts into visual and text features, showing part boundaries are a strong prior linking geometry to open-vocabulary function words.

multi-label-affordance-mapping-from-egoc.en: Builds EPIC-Aff by localizing egocentric interactions in 3D maps, training multi-label segmentation that lets one scene region carry several spatial affordances.

multi-view-rgbd-visual-affordance-datase.en: Multi-view RGB-D captures of objects with affordance annotations, benchmarking affordance segmentation and recognition across viewpoints.

multimodal-attention-based-instruction-f.en: Fuses sentence-level and task-specific text features with multiscale visual features via attention to segment part-level affordances, not just object-level regions.

naturalvlm-leveraging-fine-grained-natur.en: Decomposes long-horizon instructions with an MLLM into contact points and end-effector poses, treating manipulation as task-conditioned affordance constraint reasoning.

nyuv2-affordance-annotations.en: Affordance annotations layered on NYUv2 indoor scene images, benchmarking scene-level affordance segmentation in cluttered real-world environments.

o2o-afford-annotation-free-large-scale-o.en: Simulates object-object interactions and uses object-kernel point convolution to learn fine-grained cross-object affordance maps without human annotation.

o3afford-one-shot-3d-object-to-object-af.en: Grounds object-to-object relation affordances from a single example and transfers them via correspondence and LLM-derived task constraints into executable manipulation.

object-affordance-based-multimodal-fusio.en: Fuses CNN-detected object affordances with spoken-intention parsing to select and grasp the intended object, mapping implicit needs like thirst to affordances.

object-affordance-detection-with-boundar.en: Preserves object and part boundaries during affordance segmentation, showing boundary supervision keeps actionable regions from bleeding past part edges.

object-affordance-detection-with-relatio.en: Models affordance co-occurrence and object-affordance relations for dense labeling, showing functional co-occurrence structure improves segmentation consistency.

object-based-affordances-detection-with-.en: Couples object detection with CNN affordance prediction and dense-CRF boundary refinement, showing localize-then-refine outperforms whole-image segmentation in clutter.

one-shot-3-d-affordance-learning-for-mul.en: Lifts one-shot 2D verb-centric affordance labels into a view-consistent 3D Gaussian splatting field, then executes GPD 6-DoF grasps for multi-stage manipulation.

one-shot-affordance-detection.en: Transfers affordance from a single human-interaction exemplar to novel objects, showing affordance generalizes across categories from one support image.

one-shot-affordance-grounding-of-deforma.en: Grounds one-shot affordances of deformable objects in egocentric organizing scenes via structural semantics, keypoint geometry, and instance-conditional prompts.

one-shot-object-affordance-detection-in-.en: Estimates action purpose from a support image and transfers it to detect matching affordance regions across cluttered natural scenes beyond fixed category supervision.

one-shot-open-affordance-learning-with-f.en: Leverages semantic and correspondence priors of CLIP and DINOv2 to learn open-vocabulary affordance grounding from a single annotated example per base class.

one-shot-transfer-of-affordance-regions-.en: Transfers affordance masks from one annotated exemplar via dense correspondences built on foundation visual features, requiring no category-level training.

open-vocabulary-3d-affordance-understand.en: Enhances functional text descriptions and aligns them with point features at multiple levels to ground both labels and questions in open-vocabulary 3D affordance.

open-vocabulary-affordance-detection-in-.en: Aligns CLIP text embeddings with point-cloud features through a text-conditioned decoder, enabling open-vocabulary affordance detection beyond fixed 3D label sets.

open-vocabulary-affordance-detection-usi.en: Distills open-vocabulary knowledge into a 3D point cloud backbone and correlates text with points, handling unseen affordance labels while keeping geometric robustness.

open-vocabulary-part-based-grasping.en: Chains open-vocabulary detection, part segmentation, and 6-DoF grasp prediction to grasp language-specified object parts without task-specific training.

opra.en: Product demonstration videos paired with static object images, benchmarking video-to-image affordance grounding and interaction hotspot prediction.

ova-fields-weakly-supervised-open-vocabu.en: Aligns open-vocabulary operation descriptions with continuous 3D affordance fields under weak supervision, localizing robot operational parts beyond fixed part labels.

oval-grasp-open-vocabulary-affordance-lo.en: Uses an LLM to select task-relevant parts and a VLM to segment them into actionable heatmaps, executing open-vocabulary task-oriented grasps on real objects.

oval-prompt-open-vocabulary-affordance-l.en: Prompts an LLM for task-relevant part descriptions and localizes them with VLM/SAM, enabling open-vocabulary affordance localization without policy training.

palm-progress-aware-policy-learning-via-.en: Distills interaction-centric affordance features and predicts continuous subtask progress inside a VLA, stabilizing stage transitions in long-horizon manipulation.

panoaffordancenet-towards-holistic-affor.en: Grounds scene affordances in 360-degree panoramas via distortion-aware spectral modulation and spherical densification, extending grounding beyond perspective views.

part-aware-open-vocabulary-3d-affordance.en: Generates part-aware queries with an LLM and aligns semantic and geometric prototypes for point grounding, enabling cross-object part-level open-vocabulary transfer.

partafford.en: 3D objects with part-level annotations for cross-category affordance discovery, benchmarking weakly supervised part-affordance correspondence learning.

partafford-part-level-affordance-discove.en: Discovers 3D part-affordance correspondences from object-level affordance sets alone, combining slot attention with cuboidal primitive regularization.

pavlm-advancing-point-cloud-based-afford.en: Aligns point-cloud tokens with language queries in a VLM for 3D affordance QA and segmentation, using LLM semantics to supply open-vocabulary affordance labels.

phrase-based-affordance-detection-via-cy.en: Detects scene regions matching an affordance phrase via cyclic bilateral vision-language interaction, letting free-form action purposes select image areas.

piad.en: Paired 2D interaction images and 3D object point clouds, benchmarking the grounding of 3D affordance regions from demonstrations shown in 2D imagery.

preafford-universal-affordance-based-pre.en: Predicts point-level affordances for pre-grasp pushing and reorientation, planning preparatory actions via relay training that make hard objects graspable.

raap-retrieval-augmented-affordance-pred.en: Retrieves similar interaction images and aligns actions across them to predict contact and direction, letting small-data robots generalize affordance to unseen objects.

ragnet.en: Images with reasoning-linked affordance masks, benchmarking reasoning-based affordance segmentation and general grasping affordance grounding.

ragnet-large-scale-reasoning-based-affor.en: Builds a large-scale reasoning-rich grasp affordance segmentation benchmark and trains language-conditioned models, pushing grasp affordance beyond single-label masks.

ram-retrieval-based-affordance-transfer-.en: Retrieves 2D affordances from a unified memory of robot, HOI, and custom data via language, then lifts them to 3D executable affordances for zero-shot manipulation.

reasoning-about-object-affordances-in-a-.en: Encodes object, attribute, and affordance facts in a Markov Logic Network knowledge base, enabling zero-shot affordance inference without per-affordance classifiers.

reasoning-mamba-hypergraph-guided-region.en: Models region relations with a hypergraph-guided Mamba for weakly supervised grounding, combining local part cues with global region context from interaction images.

recognizing-object-affordances-to-suppor.en: Pairs category-agnostic region proposals with affordance recognition, shifting manipulation reasoning from category priors to region-level function on novel objects.

rekep-spatio-temporal-reasoning-of-relat.en: Generates 3D semantic keypoints and constraint functions from VLMs, then solves hierarchical optimization to produce SE(3) pose sequences for multi-stage tasks.

relationship-oriented-affordance-learnin.en: Builds a manipulation relationship graph to predict object-object action relations, grounding scene affordances in inter-object function, not per-object attributes.

resource-efficient-affordance-grounding-.en: Injects depth as bypass prompts and text-guided attention-head selection into an RGB encoder, cutting parameters while sharpening functional region localization.

rlafford-end-to-end-affordance-learning-.en: Trains affordance representations end-to-end inside RL using contact success signals, letting affordance emerge as internal policy features from interaction.

robo-abc-affordance-generalization-beyon.en: Builds an affordance memory and transfers contact regions to novel objects via diffusion-based semantic correspondence, generalizing manipulation beyond categories.

roboafford.en: Image-based affordance VQA data covering object affordance recognition and prediction plus spatial affordance localization for robotic manipulation.

roboafford-a-generative-ai-enhanced-data.en: Builds a generative-AI-expanded VQA dataset covering object, placement, and navigation affordances, moving MLLMs from scene understanding toward actionability.

robopoint-a-vision-language-model-for-sp.en: Instruction-tunes a VLM on synthetic visual-prompting data to predict spatial interaction points, converting high-level language into executable spatial constraints.

robopoint-data.en: Image data with spatial affordance point annotations, benchmarking point-level affordance prediction for robot manipulation, navigation, and AR assistance.

rt-affordance-affordances-are-versatile-.en: Proposes language-conditioned affordance plans at the high level and conditions a low-level policy on them, offering a lighter interface than goal images or sketches.

scaleadfg.en: 3D data pairing object affordances with dexterous hand grasps, benchmarking affordance-based functional grasp generation.

scaleadfg-affordance-based-dexterous-fun.en: Automatically synthesizes a scalable affordance-based functional dexterous grasp dataset and trains a lightweight grasp generator, resolving hand-object scale mismatch.

scenefun3d.en: 3D indoor scene data annotated with functional interactive elements, benchmarking functionality segmentation, task-driven affordance grounding, and 3D motion estimation.

scenefun3d-fine-grained-functionality-an.en: Annotates fine-grained functional elements, interaction regions, and motions in real indoor scans, benchmarking affordance understanding at scene rather than object level.

sceneteract-agentic-functional-affordanc.en: Pairs VLM activity decomposition with 3D reachability and clearance checks, casting scene affordance as agent-specific physical feasibility and a reward engine.

selective-contrastive-learning-for-weakl.en: Applies selective prototypical and pixel contrastive learning that adapts between part and object granularity, matching supervision granularity to each affordance.

seqafford-sequential-3d-affordance-reaso.en: Decomposes complex instructions with an MLLM and sequentially generates 3D affordance maps, treating affordance as a step-varying state in long-horizon tasks.

seqaffordsplat-scene-level-sequential-af.en: Performs multi-step instruction decomposition and sequential affordance updates on 3D Gaussian splatting scenes, using the renderable representation as scene memory.

sor3d-aff.en: Human-object interaction videos with affordance masks, benchmarking affordance segmentation from HOI footage and cross-dataset affordance evaluation.

strap-structured-object-affordance-segme.en: Recovers dense affordance masks from sparse point labels by modeling label and spatial affinities, exploiting multi-label co-occurrence structure in a transformer.

task-aware-3d-affordance-segmentation-vi.en: Couples language-driven 2D affordance detection with 3D geometric refinement, letting semantic cues locate targets while geometry enforces physical consistency.

text-driven-affordance-learning-from-ego.en: Predicts 2D contact points and trajectories from egocentric video using text-driven supervision scaled by TextAFF80K, extending affordance labels without manual masks.

towards-affordance-aware-robotic-dextero.en: Combines human motion priors, negative-affordance segmentation, and teacher-student distillation so dexterous grasps avoid functionally forbidden regions.

towards-affordance-detection-for-robot-m.en: Couples part segmentation and affordance detection so each supervises the other, showing geometric part structure strongly explains object function.

tracer-texture-robust-affordance-chain-o.en: Decomposes task semantics via tree-structured affordance chain-of-thought and refines boundaries into continuous functional regions on deformable objects.

training-agents-with-interactive-reinfor.en: Integrates contextual affordances into interactive RL to avoid failure states, showing affordances can act as prior constraints on action selection.

uad-unsupervised-affordance-distillation.en: Distills VLM-generated instruction-affordance pseudo labels into a light decoder on frozen visual features, yielding task-conditioned affordance without human labels.

umd-rgb-d-part-affordance-dataset.en: RGB-D images of tools with pixel-wise part affordance labels, benchmarking part affordance detection/segmentation and generalization to novel tools and categories.

uniaff-a-unified-representation-of-affor.en: Unifies tool-use and articulation affordances with 3D motion constraints, using a VLM to infer motion type and axes for interpretable manipulation reasoning.

unlocking-3d-affordance-segmentation-wit.en: Transfers 2D VFM semantic affinities into a 3D encoder for prompt-aware affordance segmentation, using dense 2D relations to offset sparse, noisy point clouds.

vat-mart-learning-visual-action-trajecto.en: Learns per-point actionability with post-contact trajectory proposals via interaction in simulation, extending affordance beyond contact points for articulated objects.

vida.en: Videos paired with 3D geometry for video-based 3D affordance grounding, benchmarking affordance reasoning and segmentation.

videoafford-grounding-3d-affordance-from.en: Grounds 3D affordance from human-object interaction videos via a latent action encoder and MLLM, exploiting dynamic video as causal and temporal affordance evidence.

visual-affordance-detection-using-an-eff.en: Embeds lightweight attention and dilated residual features in an encoder-decoder, capturing long-range multi-scale functional relations for pixel-wise affordance masks.

visual-affordance-prediction-for-guiding.en: Predicts plausible future states with a Transformer over a VQ-VAE latent space and samples them as exploration goals for goal-conditioned policy learning.

visual-geometric-collaborative-guidance-.en: Combines visual and geometric cues to mine interactive affinity from human-object interactions, adding geometric priors that improve cross-environment generalization.

voxposer-composable-3d-value-maps-for-ro.en: Uses LLM-written code with VLM grounding to compose 3D value maps of affordances and constraints, which a model-based planner turns into 6-DoF trajectories.

weakly-supervised-affordance-detection.en: Learns object affordance regions from weak image-level and keypoint labels, showing affordances are learnable from incomplete annotation but lean on category priors.

weakly-supervised-affordance-grounding-g.en: Generates and refines pseudo masks from VFM part-level semantic priors, showing part priors sharply cut pixel-annotation cost for weakly supervised grounding.

weakly-supervised-multimodal-affordance-.en: Fuses exocentric interaction cues with textual action descriptions to ground egocentric affordances, cutting the need for pixel-level supervision.

what-can-i-do-here-learning-new-skills-b.en: Imagines plausible outcomes with a generative visual affordance model to direct goal-conditioned exploration, accelerating acquisition of new skills.

where2act-from-pixels-to-actions-for-art.en: Predicts per-point actionability, action proposals, and success scores on articulated objects, then executes them through parameterized motion primitives.

where2explore-few-shot-affordance-learni.en: Selects informative interaction trials on cross-category similar local geometry, adapting actionability models to unseen articulated categories from few interactions.

worldafford-affordance-grounding-based-o.en: Parses instructions into object-part-function queries and grounds them to affordance masks, an open-set interface for embodied perception.
